name: MaulderLand
storyline: Sixteen years after the calamity that destroyed the city of Orewells, young camerawoman Daisy Runners is sent there to file a report on its currently abandoned state. What had to be a short coverage becomes a cat-and-mouse game when she discovers the dark truth that currently rules its streets.
summary: MaulderLand is a 2D survival horror game following the adventures a young woman uncovering a terrifying conspiracy in the streets of Orewells. Run, hide and escape the many perils roaming the streets of the abandoned city and its surroundings while searching for the truth.
